chunks: Salih ibn Uqba from Uqba from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

The visitation of the believer for the sake of Allah is better than freeing ten believing women, and whoever frees a believing woman, every limb protects a limb from the Fire, to the extent that the private part protects the private part.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward of visiting a believer compared to freeing slaves?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni highlights Ziyarat al-Mu'min (visiting the believer) as a superior act of worship, comparing its merit to freeing ten believing women from slavery. This tradition underscores the holistic spiritual protection granted by strengthening communal bonds, where every limb is shielded from the Hellfire, reflecting the Shia emphasis on social solidarity as a means of divine intercession and purification.
